newsitem.title: USA: Lernout & Hauspie acquires German co.
newsitem.headline: Lernout & Hauspie acquires German co.

text.p: Lernout & Hauspie Speech Products said it had acquired all Gesellschaft fuer Multilinguale System GmbH, a Munich-based machine translation service provider, for about $14.7 million.

Under the deal, Lernout & Hauspie paid $10.7 million in cash and $4 million in newly issued shares of common stock. The company said the acquisition is expected to be non-dilutive for 1997 and is expected to contribute to the company's earnings thereafter.

The acquisition is part of L&H's long-term strategy designed to strengthen its position in the translation market and help it fulfil its goal of quickly bringing to market a multi-lingual Internet translation service offering, it said.
L&H said it planned to offer a pilot of its Internet/intranet translation service by the end of this year for professional and business users for Spanish-English and German-English language pairs.
